section_1_tools.title: distribution.dev
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: As an aspiring PM, understanding how products find users is key. This tool lets you run developer-focused ad campaigns across multiple sites at once, giving you a practical look at developer marketing channels.

section_1_tools.title: Granular.Build
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: AI agents are transforming how software is built and managed. Playing with this visual workspace for AI agents helps you understand how future product features and internal workflows might be architected.

section_1_tools.title: Clam AI
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Email and communication overload is a massive productivity killer for PMs. This tool gives you a firsthand look at how AI-driven inbox management can save time on daily triage.

section_1_tools.title: Viktor Code
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: As an engineering student moving into PM, bridging the gap between business requirements and codebase context is vital. Coding agents that understand company-specific context show you how technical debt and product velocity intersect.

section_1_tools.title: Claude Ship
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Shipping fast is a superpower for early-stage PMs who like to build prototypes. This tool demonstrates how AI can accelerate the engineering loop from code creation to deployment.

section_2_ai_news.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Autonomous code review and deployment tools are changing engineering workflows. Knowing how these capabilities work helps you better scope technical timelines and manage developer productivity as a PM.

section_2_ai_news.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: This partnership is a prime example of conversational commerce and AI agent integrations in retail. Studying use cases like this helps you think about user journeys when monetization meets conversational AI.

section_2_ai_news.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Embedding AI assistants into mainstream messaging apps changes how users discover information and services. It is a great case study in feature distribution and user engagement for consumer tech PMs.

section_2_ai_news.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Understanding the current limitations of AI agents helps you spot genuine user pain points and avoid over-engineering features when designing AI products for your future interviews.

section_2_ai_news.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Data privacy and security are massive hurdles for enterprise AI adoption. Knowing how startups tackle privacy-first AI design gives you talking points for B2B product strategy questions.

section_3_india_news.title: Sarvam AI Launches Dictation API For English, 22 Indian Languages
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Localization is everything in the Indian tech market. As a PM building for India, having access to robust multilingual voice APIs opens up huge opportunities for voice-first applications.

section_3_india_news.title: Data Security Startup Matters.AI Nets ₹115 Cr From Tanglin Venture Partners, Others
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Enterprise SaaS and data security are drawing heavy funding in India. Tracking these funding rounds helps you understand which B2B sectors are growing and hiring software talent.

section_3_india_news.title: Shadowfax To Acquire WeFast To Expand Into Intra-City Deliveries
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Logistics consolidation in India directly impacts quick-commerce and delivery apps. Analyzing these acquisitions gives you insight into marketplace supply chains and operational strategy.

section_3_india_news.title: RBI Proposes ‘Stop Switch’ To Block Digital Payment Frauds
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Regulatory compliance and fraud prevention heavily influence fintech product design in India. PMs working in payments must design features that seamlessly adapt to regulatory mandates.

section_3_india_news.title: Most Consumer Platforms Rife With Dark Patterns Despite Regulatory Action: Survey
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Understanding dark patterns is crucial for ethical product design and UX critique rounds in APM interviews. This survey highlights real compliance risks consumer apps face today.
